rows.label: Prelude to War
rows.note: Chimera Prologue, Erra, and The Maker

conditions: The New War is at the end of the main quest spine, including The Sacrifice. These are its direct equipment and quest requirements.
Do not pre-farm a Necramech or Paracesis for this: those requirements were removed, and the quest provides a Necramech for its short section.
bonuses: A Ticker crewmate set to Engineer and free Sigma-series Railjack parts from a clan dojo make the Railjack sequences very forgiving.

groups.meta: guaranteed; no RNG or Foundry time
conditions: The reward arrives built with a free weapon slot, an Orokin Catalyst, and four innate polarities. There is no blueprint, drop table, crafting cost, or replay reward.
The weapon is untradeable. Do not sell it: replaying the quest does not award another copy.
bonuses: Its Perfect Shot is a native charge mechanic, not an Incarnon form; Nataruk has no Incarnon Evolution or Duviri route to complete.

disclosures.title: quest prep, not gear grind
disclosures.body: The quest is long but has save points, and it cannot permanently trap a player. Bring your familiar frame and weapons; the practical prep is a working Railjack and an Amp, not an endgame Necramech build.

groups.place: ORB VALLIS OR PLAINS OF EIDOLON

rows.label: Simaris Standing
rows.note: repurchase cost; roughly 3-5 capped days at high MR
rows.alt: Daily Synthesis Target turn-in after capping can exceed the daily cap

conditions: This entire route is only for a previously sold Nataruk; quest completion gives the normal copy immediately.
Turn on enemy highlighting in Accessibility, stay about 150m up, and scan red enemy silhouettes before they notice you. Alerted enemies award less standing.
On Orb Vallis, loop Temple of Profit to the nearby anti-air emplacement and back to refresh targets. On Plains, Hek's Stiletto is an easy scanning anchor.
bonuses: The Cross-Matrix Widget can double scans and the Sol-Battery Widget removes scanner charges, but their standing costs compete directly with the 100,000 needed here.
Ivara, Loki, or Octavia on Steel Path stealth Exterminate is a slower alternative if Archwing scanning is not appealing.

disclosures.title: bank the overflow correctly
disclosures.body: First reach the daily Simaris standing cap through scans, then turn in the Daily Synthesis Target. Its standing reward ignores the cap, so turning it in first wastes the overflow.

conditions: Confirm the offering in-game before spending: the research could not verify whether this copy also includes the quest reward's pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
The four polarities are innate to Nataruk and are not dependent on the quest reward copy.
